purpose: Execute the atomic extract-closed-volume operation within the MA-25 boundary: One extraction of an already enclosed volume seeded on a current face through VolumeExtract.Create. It does not cap, repair, heal, name, or otherwise prepare an open boundary.
trigger: Use when the build plan requires extract-closed-volume and all declared inputs have been resolved for the current SpaceClaim V21 action boundary.

inputs.name: source_body
inputs.description: The current closed source body whose enclosed region is extracted.

inputs.name: seed_face
inputs.description: The current face containing the supplied seed point.

inputs.name: seed_point_mm
inputs.description: Finite seed point in millimetres; it must lie on seed_face within tolerance.

inputs.name: position_tolerance_mm
inputs.description: Tolerance for projecting the seed point onto the trimmed seed face.

preconditions: source_body is a current closed positive-volume root DesignBody and seed_face belongs to it.
seed_point_mm projects onto the supplied trimmed seed face within position_tolerance_mm.
position_tolerance_mm is finite and nonnegative; the enclosed region is already valid for native extraction.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: The unique closed positive-volume DesignBodyGeneral occurrence in the new direct-root extraction component's Content.Bodies; source_body remains a preserved root DesignBody.

postconditions: VolumeExtract.Create succeeds with share topology, imprint capping edges, and merge-created-volume options disabled.
Exactly one new direct-root extraction Component is detected; its Content.Bodies contains one closed positive-volume DesignBodyGeneral occurrence, and the source root DesignBody remains present.

implementation.target_environment: SpaceClaim V21 / IronPython 2.7 action wrapper; runtime execution is evidenced by the attached exact candidate host record; native persistence, visual review, and requested export remain outside this action.
implementation.notes: Execute the atomic extract-closed-volume operation within the MA-25 boundary: One extraction of an already enclosed volume seeded on a current face through VolumeExtract.Create. It does not cap, repair, heal, name, or otherwise prepare an open boundary. Untested variants remain outside the attached exact-run evidence.

ambiguity_checks: Zero or multiple matches must stop the action; numbered aliases and return order are not valid identity criteria.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: Root components and bodies are enumerated before and after VolumeExtract.Create; the new component's Content.Bodies is reacquired before downstream use.

failure_modes.condition: Source/face ownership or seed-point projection validation fails before extraction.
failure_modes.detection: Source/face ownership or seed-point projection validation fails before extraction.
failure_modes.safe_state: Stop downstream use until the declared recovery is completed from a clean state.

failure_modes.condition: VolumeExtract.Create reports failure or no unique new closed positive-volume body is found.
failure_modes.detection: VolumeExtract.Create reports failure or no unique new closed positive-volume body is found.
failure_modes.safe_state: Treat the document as potentially partially mutated; do not promote downstream references.

recovery.action: Re-enumerate current topology, supply a seed on the current face, and rerun only for an already enclosed region; no extraction call is expected.
Treat the root document as potentially partially mutated, reopen a clean run-owned copy, and diagnose enclosure/seed feasibility before rerunning.
